assertions.subject: fixture identity
assertions.exact_expected: Every source content_sha256 equals SHA-256 of source text, or asset_ref for F2-V; all document scopes, source IDs, and locators are unique and non-empty.

assertions.subject: canonical requests
assertions.exact_expected: For every expected plan, canonical request UTF-8 bytes and SHA-256 equal the listed payload_bytes and payload_sha256.

assertions.subject: F3-D independent proposition
assertions.exact_expected: F3-D has eligibility independent_eligible, its stated independent_proposition, a zero-context 396-byte request with hash 2730591a975754ac62e185e3bf58146c66ffd6c23714a1d97f0d131e1010c42e, and a completed ledger row.

assertions.subject: F3-C overflow
assertions.exact_expected: F3-C direct essential closure is [F3-C,F3-D]; its canonical request is 4551 bytes and hash 93e9b1c3a7b449bad5ef802fe137eb03ccc5e35dfdea85f05fa4541a2359947f; it is deferred for IRREDUCIBLE_ESSENTIAL_CLOSURE_OVERFLOW.

assertions.subject: multihop essential closure
assertions.exact_expected: F3-H closure is [F3-H,F3-I,F3-J] with I and J context, 652 bytes, and hash d69e01fe1793c483a85bc7230e67800cdfcca6ef2166e7614d659bf68992d6e8; F3-I closure includes F3-J.

assertions.subject: nonessential edge exclusion and cycles
assertions.exact_expected: F3-COMP-AB and F3-OPTIONAL-BC contribute no request context; E and F have no plans and each ledger row is ESSENTIAL_DEPENDENCY_CYCLE with members [F3-E,F3-F].

assertions.subject: F2 asset and partial coverage
assertions.exact_expected: F2-P completes; F2-T defers on F2-E-REJECTED; F2-V defers as MEANINGFUL_ASSET_UNINTERPRETED with interpreted=false and non_fact=false; coverage is partial, accepted=false, semantic_ready=false.

assertions.subject: document coverage and ownership
assertions.exact_expected: F1 coverage is complete; F2 and F3 coverage are partial; every inventory source has exactly one ledger row; an owner never also appears as context in that request.

assertions.subject: negative matrix
assertions.exact_expected: N-01 through N-09 each has one exact result and reason/hash; no case permits silent truncation, false acceptance, or incomplete closure.

assertions.subject: manifest integrity
assertions.exact_expected: Every listed raw and canonical hash matches; the manifest self hash equals SHA-256 of its canonical form excluding manifest_sha256.
